review_description: We did our research and, after a number of quotes, we decided to proceed with Hills Natural Solar installing a 40kw SigEnergy Sigenstore battery as a retrofit to our existing solar panels.Dealing initially with Philip we found the quotation process, including answering a myriad of our questions, dealt with professionally and in a timely, and most importantly, knowledgeable way. We agreed to proceed with HNS as their pricing was good and we knew we were dealing with a reputable local installer.Once we agreed to proceed, the contracting, scheduling and final pre install process was organised through Aishah who was a delight to deal with.The final day of installation came and it was as promised. Matt and his team were on time, efficient and cleaned up behind themselves. They were always courteous and, going above our expectations, delivered a fantastic product.

Quote process was fast factual and Philip knew what he was talking about and promptly answered any of my concerns.Install was fast. All the trades on site did great professional work.I highly recommend using Hills Natural Solar.

I really enjoyed working with the Hills Natural Solar family business. Everyone was extremely helpful and friendly. The quote was fair, provided a great system and gave good advice on panel position to get the best use out of the solar panels. I would 100% recommend this business.

We recently had our Sigenergy home battery installed by Hills Natural Solar, and the experience was excellent from start to finish. The team was quick to respond to all our questions and kept us informed throughout the process, even when minor issues arose.The installation itself went smoothly, and they made sure to clean up thoroughly afterwards. The battery has been working perfectly, and we truly appreciate the professionalism shown at every stage—from the initial quotation to post-install support.Highly recommend Hills Natural Solar for anyone considering solar or battery solutions. Their customer service and attention to detail really stood out.
The installation process was well planned and went without a hitch. Customer service was helpful and friendly. I would recommend this installer.

I got a quote for panels and a battery in April this year from Phil but decided to wait until the rebates were finalised. After the dust had settled, I asked for a new quote. Site inspection and installation dates were organised by Aishah and the communication was faultless. When Matt came out to do a site inspection, it turned out that it was not possible to install additional panels despite Matt and his capable assistant (whose name I never got) looking at all options. We ended up going with just a battery.I would highly recommend Hills Natural Solar for battery installation. I would gladly go with them for panels if we had the need.

We purchased a Sigenergy 48kWh battery, 25kW inverter and 16kW of panels to replace our 15-year-old solar system.  Hills Natural Solar were very responsive in the design and specification process, coming up with several alternatives as our ideas evolved.  The installation commenced on the appointed day and proceeded smoothly.  Everything they promised was delivered and my house was left exactly as they found it.  The job reflects attention to detail in a clean and tidy installation and it has been delivering to specification from day one.  As I write this, a month has passed and the system has worked without any issues throughout that time.  By coincidence we had a black out last week and everything kept working in our house, there was not one single clock to reset or computer to reboot - again, exactly as promised.  In summary, by our standards this was a very significant purchase - we took the plunge based on our first impressions dealing with Hills Natural Solar and reading other customer reviews and I am pleased to say that we are delighted with the outcome.

Hills Natural Solar took the time to explain the system at the quoting phase, listen to my requirements and build something that was very suitable, which integrated my existing Fronius solar system. There were no pressure-sales tactics, and the transaction was easy.A visit was first made to perform a site survey, two weeks prior to installation, at which point Matt discussed all the options and helped us get an ideal location, and again, ensure that everything was ready.On install day, they turned up promptly, professionally installed the product and got everything done by just after lunch time.All in all, highly recommended installer.

Hills Natural Solar, a small business that help you work around all issues and have your back all the way.Phil was awesome to tailor made our system, with his wealth of knowledge  he answered all our questions quickly . He came by to inspect the site to ensure he has all corners covered.Matt with his team installed the solar system with battery quickly and perfectly, he had setup and explained  the app and how system works and behaves in all scenarios. He also went above and beyond the scope of work to future proof  our home (installed extra conduit in the trench between our garage and home ).Aishah was always there for us and very quick to respond.If you want a worry free and perfect installation, these guys are there for you.Thank you Hills Natural Solar team.

Hills Natural Solar has just completed the installed of a 12.35 kw solar and 24Kwh battery system. I undertook an extensive quoting and evaluation process before selecting Hills Natural Solar for this job.  Everything about the engagement, installation and after sales process was excellent - Aishah was great to deal from the first phone call,  answering many, many questions I had about the technical details of the product and the whole process of installation, including the government rebates etc. Matt was friendly, knowledgeable, and very helpful when I needed to change the date for the removal of my old solar system so I could organise a roofer to replace part of the roof before the new system could be installed.Aishah's customer service is incredible and she was always available to immediately answer questions and find solutions to any queries . Nothing was too much trouble and she kept me up to date throughout the whole process. I could not fault the whole experience with Matt and Aishah. I would highly recommend Hills Natural Solar.

Hills Natural Solar assessed our needs and gave us a very competitive quote on a number of Solar+battery systems.  The sales rep was punctual and most informative.   Overall, it was their attention to detail and thorough, accurate, easy to understand, paperwork which sold us on this quality company – plus the fact that they install the system themselves without relying on contractors.  The front office kept us informed every step of the way.  The installation over one and a half days was very professionally done and they cleaned up after themselves.  Every person we met from this company was very polite and obliging.  After the install they showed us how to use the system, what continues to work or doesn't work during a blackout and what to do if an electrician needs to turn the system off for any reason.  They helped us install the App and explained its functions.  We thoroughly recommend Hills Natural Solar and wish Matt, Aishah, Phill and the Hills Natural Solar team every success.

We started the process at about the worst time, a couple of months before the federal rebate kicked in. Phillip, Matt and Aishah explained everything clearly, including the unknowns at the time, worked through multiple quotes with us and ultimately installed a fantastic system.All communication was prompt, clear and helpful, and the installation itself was painless (except for the wifi, sorry about that ?). The whole crew was highly professional.We're very happy with the results and wouldn't hesitate to recommend Hills to anyone.

Both Aishah and Matt were a pleasure to work with. The process was enjoyable and very easy thanks to excellent communication from Aishah in particular. The installation was quick, tidy and our system is working very well. We are very happy and would highly recommend Hills Natural Solar.

The quoting process was smooth and transparent, no pushy sales tactics, just clear advice and honest recommendations. They tailored the system around our needs, with battery placement and grid connection requirements thoughtfully considered from the beginning.Installation day was handled professionally. The team arrived on time, worked efficiently, and left the site spotless. They were polite throughout and happy to answer questions without rushing.After commissioning, the customer service didn’t stop. Hills Natural Solar helped set up the mySigen app, walked us through battery monitoring features, and made sure our grid connection was handled seamlessly. They also checked in post install to ensure everything was running smoothly.Would highly recommend their team for anyone looking for a battery system with proper follow through.

We recently had our solar system installed by Hills Natural Solar, and the experience from start to finish was excellent. Being a local, family-run business, they really took the time to understand our needs and explain the options clearly during the quoting process. There was no pressure just honest advice and a fair price.The installation itself went smoothly. The team was punctual, polite, and very tidy. They respected our home and cleaned up thoroughly once the job was done. You could tell they took pride in their work.What really stood out was the customer service. After the install, they helped organise the grid connection and made sure we understood how everything worked, including walking us through how to monitor the system. It made the whole process stress-free.I’d happily recommend Hills Natural Solar to anyone looking for a reliable and friendly solar installer.

Couldn't be happier with my solar PV system from Hills Natural Solar. In an industry not known for its great customer service, these guys stand out well ahead of the pack. They were knowledgeable and helpful every step of the way. Even after the job was done, they repeatedly followed up with the solar inverter company to get a minor issue rectified with the monitoring app. I'm an electronics engineer by training and pretty fussy. The installation was done extremely well. I highly recommend this company. And my last bill was $127 compared with $600 the same time the previous year! For a two person townhouse with no battery, that's great - better than I was expecting.

Great product and industry knowledge.Friendly and considerate phone conversationsNeat, punctual and efficient installationVery considerate of pre-planning our vehicle access and schedules during installing.Great follow up service
Great customer service, self install. Would highly recommend Hills Natural Solar.

The first quote from Matt seemed excessive as I was after ~10-15kWh battery but received a quote for 24kWh. How ironic that after a few rounds of different quotes and configurations, I actually decided for the very first one!We had a few road bumps during the inspection and after, dealing with various limitations around battery location, some proved to be fixable and some not. I was already giving up when Aishah came up with an idea and not only it worked, it was even better solution than I initially hoped for!The system was installed a week later, it took about half day which is not too bad considering the battery is on the opposite side of the house from the switchboard and gateway.It's been 3 weeks since the installation and I can't be happier. So far it works as expected, including the integration into my Home Assistant for which Matt kindly called Sigenergy support to enable a specific feature in my system to allow integration.

Can't recommend Hills Natural Solar more highly.  Both Aishah and Matt were professional and easy to deal with.  At no stage in the process did I feel like I was being given the hard sell, they were just upfront and honest and gave suggestions on what would be the best solar setup for our family and home.  The install was done quickly and efficiently and to a high standard.  Even post install when we were having issues with our energy provider changing our meter Aishah and Matt both went out of their way to try and help us even though it wasn't really their issue.   Overall a great experience and would recommend them to family and friends.

I had a fantastic experience with Hills Natural Solar from start to finish. Their team was professional, efficient, and highly skilled. The installation process was seamless, with a fast turnaround and impressive attention to detail. The installers not only did a top-notch job fitting the system but also went the extra mile—taking care of cracked roof tiles and leaving the site spotless. Nothing was ever too much trouble, and their customer service was outstanding. I highly recommend Hills Natural Solar to anyone considering solar!

One of the three installers recommended by Solarquotes was Hills Natural Solar Pty. Ltd., a family company, with Aishah and Matt, the owners, who responded enthusiastically and courteously to my queries and provided suggestions for the best system quote among the three options for the client. As a result, I selected them as the installer for this 6.6kw system.The installation was seamless, and I am very satisfied with the result. The team was polite, thorough in addressing all my questions, meticulous in their work, and efficient throughout the process. Additionally, their pricing was very competitive. In particular, Matt, the knowledgeable electrician, pointed out that placing the inverter next to the switchboard, exposed to the direct sun, would reduce its lifespan. He had it installed on the opposite side without any extra charge. I would definitely recommend Hills Natural Solar Pty Ltd to anyone looking for a reliable, and professional solar installer.

I am very happy with my solar system installed by Hills Natural Solar Pty Ltd. It is an excellent job done by Aishah and Matthew from beginning to the end and after.  Even after the installation and final payment, when I ring whether on a weekday day time,  after hours, public holiday or weekend, still Aishah picks up the phone or comes back to me within few minutes. What a great customer service.They answered all my questions and provided all technical data I requested. Aishah and Matthew guided me to select the correct Solar panel type (make) in the market to achieve high efficencies and best output with top of the range inverter type. They sold a solar system with service, not just a system. They are not pushy to sell just any solar system. They sell the correct solar system plus service before, during and after the installation.My understanding is Hills Solar is owner operated family business - Aishah and Matthew (Electrician). Aishah did all sales work for me and Mathew completed all installation work.

Recently had a 10.56kW system (24 panels) and Tesla Powerwall 3 battery installed by the team at Hills Natural Solar.Materials: My brief to Hills Natural Solar was for the installation of the Powerwall 3 given its incorporation of the battery and inverter. Regarding panels, I was seeking a quality panel that could address my energy needs and that it be all black to complement my roof. In keeping with the aesthetics, I also requested that the panels not be positioned in the front facing portion of the house.The recommended Aiko panels are a sleek black and were installed in conjunction with the black racking system and clamps, resulting in a perfect blend with the aesthetics of our roof. The panels look great and have the ability to function even in circumstances involving partial shading.The Powerwall 3 is beautiful and functional and protected by a cover (separate cost) to guard against the elements and accidental contact. Despite being a recent install, we have already received complements on the install and both my wife and I are very happy with how it turned out.Process: From the initial contact with Aishah, the planning and proposal of the install, the actual install with Matt and the team over 1.5 days and the post install, I echo the sentiments of other reviews in that the process was seamless. Aishah was fantastic in managing the admin side and was not only responsive to my queries but proactive in anything that required my attention.Matt was all that I could ask for in fulfilling the install: top bloke, punctual, knowledgeable, answered my questions, explained the system and most importantly, completed the job within time, in a neat manner and to a high standard.Overall: I strongly recommend Hills Natural Solar if you are seeking a quality and seamless installation to address your individual solar needs.When it comes to something as long term as solar, doing it right the first time is crucial and something that this family owned business appears to have perfected.

Everything about the engagement, installation and after installation process was exceptional - Aishah was great to deal with, friendly, patient, not pushy but very informative and helpful with pre-sales questions, during sales process and after installation; Matt was friendly, knowledgeable, not pushy, thoughtful about the design taking account of our shade issues, prompt, polite and tidy with the installation.  HNS has been helpful with engaging with Ausgrid also.Highly recommend Hills Natural Solar.

Hills Natural Solar has just installed a 13.2 kw system, Matt and Aishah and the team were very professional and great service, they come to site, completed the job and removed all the waste.From when I received the quote to when we installed the Solar Panels it seamless, I really recommend Hills Natural Solar for anyone looking at a great service and great pricing.Matt and the team were all fantastic and very professional. Really appreciate all the work and great workmanship. Thanks so much and will refer many more customers to you.

The quote was explained and process of payment etc made clear.  I could ring and clarify any concerns.Installation was professional took one and a half days to complete. Very prompt and tidy.The installer explained how to connect to my energy supplier. The supplier made it more complicated than necessary.Instead of one page form it was 3 pages and I had to give more details on the installer than initially thought.The installer connected me to the enlighten app so I could check on usage etc.

Very easy to recommend Matt, Aishah and their team.To my mind they were just better at communicating the various options that would suite the site with its shade issues.Matt did the initial inspection and the install. Aishah politely answered all my queries on differences in panels, inverters etc and updated quotes promptly.The install went smoothly, up and running noon the second day. Phone app all good.All going well to date.

Hills Natural Solar were one of the first companies proposed by Solar Quotes to contact us with a quote.  They took the time to explain the system selection and were more than happy to adjust the quote several times based on our discussions about panels, inverters, future battery use etc.  Nothing was ever a problem and all questions and updated quotes were done very promptly.After selection, we had to move the installation date several times because of issues with availability on our side.  Again, nothing was a problem and dates were moved and confirmed very promptly and with no issue.The installation itself was flawless.  The guys arrived when they said they would, we barely knew they were here (apart from the obligatory banging noises from the roof which of course was expected) and when they were finished, how the system was setup and how it all worked and what the next steps were, were all explained to us.  Knowing that you tend to forget all this new information in the heat of the moment ... they even followed up after everyone had gone with a revision of the what needed to be done and more offers to help should we get stuck.  Oh, and every single piece of packaging, cardboard, plastic and cut wire was picked up and taken away with them.  You'd never know anyone had been here and certainly not for the amount of work that had been done !We had a minor issue with the monitoring post-install (the following day) but again, text messages, phone calls and even a return visit from Matt sorted everything out (it was actually sorted by the time he got back onsite with us !).Very happy with the entire process and our system is even running the house while it's raining (I was actually suprised to see it generating on such a dull day).  This has admittedly been our first solar install but I would consider this absolutely best in class.

Matt, Aishah and team are really friendly, prompt and punctual. They explained all the processes to me and answered all my queries patiently. The installation was a breeze. I would recommend Hills Natural Solar as we had a very good experience.

We could not fault our solar experience with Matt and Aishah. We ended up choosing Hills Natural Solar as we wanted to deal with the same people from start to finish. Matt not only designs the system for you, but he also installs it.  You don't have to worry about dealing with a sales person who promises you the world, then with a sub contractor that says it's not possible.  Aishah's customer service is amazing and she keeps you up to date throughout the whole process.  We would definitely recommend Hills Natural Solar.

The team at Hills Solar are excellent. I talked to multiple installers and what stood out for me was -- Professional and punctual- No hard sell- Owner is the installer who runs the project from design to installation. The team take pride in their work- On time, all promises kept. The actual output of the system exceeds the estimate provided upfront- Small business, family owned and operated

Hills Natural Solar was by far the best company that we engaged in. They were professional, most informed and friendly. Their quote was competitive with using the best solar product in the market.  They answered all our questions with patience and kindness. They arrived on time and installed our solar with care with their friendly team. Once installed, Hills Natural Solar connected us to the grid and made the transition into solar smoothly, and with the app, we can now monitor our solar product. Once again, because of the friendly staff and their professionalism, we went with them and it was the best decision to go with solar. Highly recommend their service Thanks Hills Natural! Kind regards, Tony

I have been wanting to install a solar system but didn't know where to start. I got quotes from a door knocker, from the internet (interstate installer) and from an electricity retailer (my son has his solar system installed from them). They were all offering string inverters. Then I got the 3 quotes from SolarQuotes, one offering only microinverters and 2 offering 3 designs available in Australia. I went with Hills Natural Solar as they were local, have the best options and good reviews that I was happy to work withSales: Prompt in providing quotes, responsive to queries about the solar panels, inverters, the installation process and their company.Design: 3 options provided based on the following Inverter technologies: string, optimizer, microinverters. Brands quoted where the best in terms of performance, reliability and warranty. Since my roof are north facing, I could have picked any design and it would be a perfect solar system producing free energy from the sun.Installation: Scheduled about 10 days from the time I put a deposit. They arrived early and started on time. It started to drizzle then but that only caused some minor delays. Matt is very professional and was able to complete the installation shortly after noon, with some time to see the solar system working. It was cloudy next 3 days and I can only see 5-6 kWh production daily but as soon as the weather cleared up, I got  up to 33 kWh production from the solar. First time right!Post Installation & Support: I even have more questions after the solar system is up and running, mainly around the application. Aishah was able to promptly replied with clear explanation.Note: The quote didn't include a consumption metering nor panel information. Only solar production information is provided with the application. I had to order them. Glad I did as with the information I got from the app,  I was able to adjust the use of my high powered electrical appliances and maximize my savings (80% self consumption). Installation of the consumption metering took just 2 hrs. Matt even took the time to replace some broken tiles they have found on my roof, not caused by their installation.Overall, Hills Natural Solar is a reliable, professional solar installer company. I would definitely recommend to anyone.

Hills Natural Solar were great throughout the process from providing detailed quotes, getting the required approvals and efficiently completing the installation with no disruptions.The level of service and communication was excellent and made everything a lot easier.I was very happy with the overall experience and would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for a solar panel installation!

We have been wanting to install solar for quite some time, but it all seemed too hard with all the calls we had made.The team at Hills Natural solar were quick, efficient, helpful and had attended a site inspection, submitted a quote and installed out system within a 10 day period!They have been just as helpful since the installation! Couldn't be happier with our choice!

The sales process was reassuring, whilst others promised the world, they didn't seem genuine, and my research backed this up.Installation was very professional and punctual with no mess.Customer service has been fantastic, my follow up queries were attended to immediately.They organized the grid connection and ran through the app and how to use it.

I recently had the pleasure of having my solar panels and EV charger installed by Hills Natural Solar, and I couldn't be happier with their service. Our installation was a little different, as we were adding more capacity to our existing system. Aishah and Matt were more than happy to tweak our quote a few times to suit our needs.Aishah, Matt, and the entire team exuded professionalism from start to finish. Not only were they quick to install the system, ensuring minimal disruption to our daily routine, but they also kept the place tidy, which was greatly appreciated. Matt also spent some time going over how to use the EV charger.Aishah and Matt were communicative and awesome to deal with, making the entire process streamlined and stress-free. It’s clear that Hills Natural Solar values its customers' satisfaction and aims to provide top-notch service. I highly recommend them to anyone looking to install solar panels or an EV charger.

The sales & quoting process was simple. Staff were helpful, friendly, professional and no pressure. Practical options were provided with honest recommendations. I was relevantly communicated with throughout the process and I felt like we were working together on the project.Installer was punctual arriving on site at the agreed time and completing within the time advised. Work was very neat and tidy. Site was thoroughly cleaned on completion and I was given a clear explanation of the systemAll post install paperwork and processes were completed on my behalf within a few hours of the site work being completeI am a very, very happy customer.

We received a few quotations for our solar system as part of our knock down rebuild. We found that Aishah and Matt were very helpful with their advice and design on the system and we liked that they were a local business.The whole process was very smooth and we were able to work in with our builder and Hills natural solar to have some work partially completed during the build and the remainder finished after handover.Matt and his team were very professional and did an excellent job with the installation.We are very happy with the quality and service received by Hills natural solar and highly recommend them.

After getting quotes from quite a few solar system providers, we have decided to go with Hills Natural Solar, which is a family run company. Aisha, Matt and the team have been great, staying engaged with us at every step of the process from the initial inquiry for a solar system all the way to the installation. Matt and the team did a great job during the installation with a minimum of disruption to our daily activities; they were very punctual and professional. We are very pleased with both the service we have received as well as the installed solar system. Highly recommended.

After getting different quotes we went with Hills Natural Solar because we preferred to have a local/smaller business doing the job. Matt came to our home to explain the different products and was professional and knowledgeable.It took us a little while to get strata approval but Aishah was patient and answering all our questions. She also assisted us with organising the grid connection after the installation and sorting out a Smart meter application.Once we had the approval a date was set within a week. Matt did a great job with the installation. He was also punctual and tidy. We would highly recommend them.

Matt, Aishah and their team were fantastic, and provided support, advice and unrivalled customer service from the initial quotation to  day of installation.Always arrived when they said they would, worked efficiently, with a minimum level of disruption to us and made sure our property was left how they found it.Whilst the system was not the cheapest option considered, it did deliver better quality options and solutions the other mass marketed systems couldn't.Extremely happy with using Hills Natural Solar.

Natural Solar were very flexible with install date, working in with the builder’s progress/ delays.The system is a (22.5 deg to the horiz) East-West-South array of Maxeon Sunpower 41 x 410W/panels, powering a house and internal granny flat (6Br), an EV via a Zappi 2 charger, and a Tesla Powerwall 2, via 2 x 8.2kW Fonius inverters.Supply is 3 phase, ducted AC load circa 8.2kW, resistive hot water converted late 2023 to Heat Pump (3.6 kW now 0.7kW).We’re located on the Central Coast.House build is 2023 North Facing Hamptons Brick Veneer. R6.0 ceilings, R2.0, windows double glazed.Solar offset over these 13months has been 121% (19.5Mwh generated, 16.1MWh consumed, which includes EV home charging (Tesla Y, 40k km/annum)).I’m an Environmental Scientist and happy to help others with their operational carbon reduction plans for their new builds. ?

Wonderful family run company to work with, they’re incredible knowledgeable and passionate about Solar.Quick communication and seamless process. They handled everything for us.Installation was tidy, punctual, they even replaced a large amount of cracked roof tiles for us.The whole Team at Hills Natural Solar were absolutely incredible to deal with. Aishah and Matt were friendly, knowledge and helpful - providing a wealth of information, timely communication and a great service from the first contact, through install and to follow up afterwards. We’re so pleased with the result and are already reaping the benefits of the panels. Without a doubt I’d recommend this great family run company for anyone considering solar!
The engagement from the beginning was honest without the marketing gimmicks. The quotes and options were clearly explained.

Aishah and Matt were excellent in answering all my questions about the system and in planning for the system to suit long term requirements such as battery and back up compatibility in the future. They were both also excellent to deal with.Install was done in an efficient, tidy and timely manner and there have been so issues that have arisen post install. All paperwork was provided very quickly.Overall, more than happy with the Hills Natural Solar.

Installing the 12.3kW (440w) Trina panels with the IQ8 Enphase Inverter System was by far the smoothest home improvement process I've ever experienced. From the outset, the customer service was exceptional. Unlike other firms, this team responded promptly to my quote request within just 48 hours—a refreshing change from the frustrating delays I encountered elsewhere. One company even left me waiting for almost two weeks, while another sent three different salespeople without any coordination.Aishah and Matt stood out for their fantastic service. They not only ensured that everything progressed swiftly but also accommodated my schedule and timeline without fail. Remarkably, from the initial quote to the system being fully operational, only six weeks elapsed—even during the busy Christmas period. They were attentive to all my requirements, never dismissing any of my preferences. I was also grateful for their suggestions which ensured I didn't make any mistakes in my choices..The quality of their work was top-notch. They arrived punctually, executed the job as promised, and left the premises in impeccable condition. I particularly appreciated the neat wiring, devoid of unsightly conduits cluttering the exterior walls— a testament to their attention to detail.With the system up and running smoothly, I've become an enthusiastic solar advocate.  I highly recommend reaching out to these professionals for a quote. Trust me, it's the easiest process you'll ever experience!

Aishah was fantastic to deal with. No hard sell and Matt visited the property to look at install. Not the cheapest but the service I felt most comfortable with. They offered alternative systems and spoke through the pros and cons of each. The installation team were polite and tided up the area. Overall very impressed with the service and follow up calls

Aishah was great to deal with right from the start. She spent time and was patient in explaining and addressing all my questions, helping me understand the benefits of different systems and designs. She was patient with weighing up the cost and benefit of options and I really appreciate her knowledge. Matt was also great at coming back to me with multiple quotes quite quickly even though I was a little indecisive. The installation timeline was very quick, pretty much a week after I signed papers and put a deposit down. I didnt have the pleasure of meeting Matt but my parents were happy with his workmanship and professionalism. The work was interrupted by the rain but it Matt went the extra mile to come back the following day -- early! -- to finish it off. It was a seamless process, right to the end when we had to try and switch our electricity plan. Aishah was helpful with trying to help us switch our electricity plan to solar. We got a little frustrated with AGL, but Aishah did what she could to assist with the process and we are grateful for the responsiveness and the time. All in all, we would highly recommend again.

Excellent sales and quoting process - we really valued the hands-on on site appraisal of our needs. Good customer service and quick responses to our questions.Installation day went very smoothly, very good workers, punctual and polite. The site was tidied on departure.We had already organised grid connection, however Hills Natural Solar offered to organise if needed.
Big thanks to Aishah and Matt for the seamless solar installation. Their professionalism and expertise exceeded expectations. I'm thrilled with the results and will happily recommend to anyone.Rachel

I have made a few studies before I decide to go with Hills Natural Solar.  I am happy that I am not dealing with sales person and then subcontractors.  Aishah is always approachable and helpful to answer my questions.  Matt has all the knowledge and qualifications to carry out the installation. His team arrived in time, was well organised and the solar system started to run smoothly on the day.I would highly recommend Hills Natural Solar

I wholeheartedly recommended Hills Natural Solar to anyone considering solar installation. From start to finish and to the after installation wifi monitor,  Aishah and Matt have carried out every process professionally and seamlessly that have exceeded our expectation in every way.You won't be disappointed with Hills Natural Solar and they truly deserve the top-rated status.

The process from quote to installation was a pleasant experienceThere was no sales pressure and the team were very respectful of the time it took us to make our decisionThe installation team were courteous, tidy and a pleasant to work withThanks for the great experience

From our first contact we found Hills Natural Solar to be helpful and prompt in answering any questions. They organised approvals and had our system installed within two weeks of acceptance. We really liked that Matt came out and personally checked our site, performing extra measurements to ensure there would be no problems on installation day. Ash (in the office) was always available to answer any queries. A sizeable team arrived and had the installation completed by mid afternoon. Now we are all set up to see our energy production on our phone app. Definitely recommend Hills Natural Solar.

Having solar installed by Hills natural solar, a local business within my area that highly recommended the enphase product as they utilise it on their own home. They install the products themselves and don't utilise sub contractors and have been helpful and contactable throughout the process.
